blocks.heading: Same chunk, better pointer
blocks.body:
A **conkeyref** is a pointer that pulls a chunk by a **name in the booklet**, not by a file path. It looks like `name/id`.

Give the library line `keys="warnings-lib"`. The how-to stores that name. Move the file. Update one booklet path. The how-tos sleep through it.

If a sentence still exists twice, you are not done.

blocks.heading: Do the work
blocks.body:
You just met the idea. Now do the lab: Same warning, now a name.

This lab can fail. Fail when: The how-to still uses a path pointer, or you copied the sentence, or the name is missing from the booklet.

Expected: Name pointers in both how-tos. The booklet holds keys="warnings-lib". Moving the file did not mean editing the how-tos. Completeness clean.

blocks.lead: Walk the cards below, in order, to Same warning, now a name.
blocks.intro: How to Same warning, now a name. Walk the cards in order. Tick them in the lab after you actually do them.

steps.title: Same warning, now a name
steps.body: This is the whole move. The next cards are the steps, in order.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: On the library page’s line in the booklet, set keys="warnings-lib".

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: In prime-the-pump.dita, change the warning from a path pointer (conref) to a name pointer: conkeyref="warnings-lib/pinch-hazard". Remove the path form.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: Move warnings.dita into topics/library/ if it is not already there. Update only the booklet line’s path. The how-to should still resolve through the name.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.body: Unset the root map. Confirm the warning looks broken. Set the root map again.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.body: Add the same name pointer to a second how-to (create topics/inflate-the-kite.dita if needed: three steps plus the warning).

steps.title: Step 6
steps.body: Completeness clean. Two how-tos, one library sentence.

blocks.lead: Answer with words from today only.
blocks.q: Why point at the library by a name in the booklet, not by a file path?
options: The booklet can retarget the library without editing every how-to
Paths are not allowed on notes
A name is shorter to type, and that is the only reason
blocks.why: Move the library, update one booklet line. The how-tos keep the name.

blocks.lead: Answer with words from today only.
blocks.q: The pointer says warnings-lib/pinch-hazard. What is pinch-hazard?
options: The id of the note inside the library page that name points at
The product name in the booklet
blocks.why: The name finds the page. The id finds the note.
